response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), status_shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), compared AS (SELECT telescope_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share_across_statuses FROM status_shares) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share_across_statuses) AS average_amount_above_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share_across_statuses;
